{"id":"mimid-1wgh.4.81.8","title":"Decision: carry DIDWebVHCredential inside opaque<V> in the MLS Credential (OpenMLS and mls-rs cannot carry the draft's encoding)","description":"draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-00 §The did:webvh Credential puts `DIDWebVHCredential did_webvh;` (a struct of two opaque<V>) directly in the select arm of RFC 9420 Credential.

Problem: OpenMLS 0.9 (credentials/mod.rs: `serialized_credential_content: VLBytes`, "The implementation only works with credentials that are encoded as variable-sized vectors") and mls-rs (CustomCredential `data` via mls_rs_codec::byte_vec) both encode every credential type they do not know as credential_type || opaque<V>. Neither can carry the draft's encoding: the parser reads did_log as the whole content and misparses witness_file as the next LeafNode field.

Readings: (a) as written, which needs an OpenMLS fork change (Mark approval per AGENTS.md) and leaves mls-rs and every other stack unable to interoperate; (b) carry the TLS encoding of DIDWebVHCredential inside the opaque<V> both libraries already use, i.e. wire = credential_type || varint(len) || did_log<V> || witness_file<V>.

Chosen: (b), INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC. mls_didwebvh::DidWebvhCredential encodes the inner struct; OpenMLS adds the outer length. A test decodes a mimid KeyPackage with mls-rs to show it is interoperable. For -01: define the arm as `opaque did_webvh<V>` holding DIDWebVHCredential, or say so in prose; new credential types in practice must be one opaque<V>. Label wg. Flag to Mark.
